page.layout: One page of text: a centred dedication block, then a list of names on the left with a brace grouping a description on the right, then a closing signature block and a catchword at the lower right. A printed page number at the top centre. Show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed.

main_text.head: VIRO Reverendo Clarissimoq;
main_text.p: Dn. WILHELMO ELERS, verbi divini in Ecclesia Borg-feldensi ministro fidelissimo, doctissimo, fautori suo æta-tem suspiciendo
Dn. JOHANNI BIFRMAN[?], Civi ac Negociatori hujus lib: Reip. Bremensis florentissimo, Patrono ac Fautori suo omni honoris cultu prosequendo.
Dn. GERHARDO Krouwell[?] / Civi ac Negociatori hujus Reip. integerrimo, prudentissimo, cognato suo fi-dissimo.

page.notes: The brace grouping the six names with the description on the right is rendered as cells separated by " | ". A brown stain lies over the right-hand text near "Philos:" and "Studiosi". Show-through of the reverse side (mirrored running head "DISPUTATIO THEOLOGICA", large mirrored display text, and the faint mirrored imprint at the lower left) is omitted. The name "BIFRMAN" and "Krouwell" are doubtful in the print. "HÜNEKEN" may read "HUNEKEN" in the original.
